notes:
Sphere Bot v1.3.7 improves desktop responsiveness and attachment access.

- Moves backup validation off the desktop thread, streams backup transfers, and reduces repeated background work.
- Adds optional Profile → Recovery with saved-copy and bot selection, progress, and protection for existing data and intentional deletions.
- Reduces VM connection setup calls and adds connection timing diagnostics.
- Keeps allowed attachments available as files regardless of model-native inputs; PDF and DOCX tools return text, and partial web uploads can be retried.
- Migrates the legacy data-root marker to the Sphere name without moving user data.

Scanned/image-only PDFs require OCR or suitable image tools. Unsupported formats retain their original file and receive a clear tool limitation.
